questions.question: Rohit and Mohit can do a piece of work in 4 days, while Ram and Shyam can do the same work in 12 days. In how many days will Rohit, Mohit, Ram and Shyam do it together?
questions.solution:
Given:

Rohit and Mohit can do a piece of work in 4 days,

while Ram and Shyam can do the same work in 12 days

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

Let total work is 12 units ( Lcm of 4 and 12)

The efficiency of Rohit and Mohit is,

⇒ 12 / 4 = 3 units

The efficiency of Ram and Shyam

⇒12 / 12 = 1 unit

Total efficiency is 3 + 1 = 4 units

Required number of days,

⇒12 / 4 = 3 days 

**∴ The correct option is 2**

questions.question: A boat can travel with a speed of 15 km/hr in still water. If the speed of the stream is 5 km/hr, find the time taken by the boat to go 80 km downstream.
questions.solution:
Given:

A boat can travel at a speed of 15 km/hr in still water.

The speed of the stream is 5 km/hr

Concept used:

Downstream speed = Boat speed + speed of the current

Distance = speed × time

Calculation:

Downstream speed will be 

⇒ 15 + 5 = 20 km

So, the time taken will be 

⇒ 80 / 20 = 4 hr

∴ The correct option is 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] __Additional Information__Upstream speed = Boat speed - speed of the current

questions.question: A work was finished by L, P and Q together. L and P together finished 50 percent part of the work and P and Q together finished 60 percent part of the work. Who among the three is most efficient?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A work was finished by L, P and Q together.

L and P together finished 50 percent part of the work 

P and Q together finished 60 percent part of the work

**Calculation:**

L and P together finished, L + P = 0.5

Then Q does 1 - 0.5 = 0.5

P and Q together finished, P + Q = 0.6

Then P does 0.6 - 0.5 = 0.1

So, L does, 0.5 - 0.1 = 0.4

**∴ Among the three Q is most efficient**

questions.question: A shopkeeper sells a book at a loss of 60 percent. Had he sold the book for Rs. 150 more, then he would have suffered a loss of 30 percent. To earn a profit of 20 percent, what should be the selling price of the book?
questions.solution:
Given:

A shopkeeper sells a book at a loss of 60 percent.

Had he sold the book for Rs. 150 more, then he would have suffered a loss of 30 percent.

Formula used:

Selling Price (Sp) = Cp + ((Profit)/(100)) × Cp

Cp = ((100)/(100space+space profitspace Percent)) × Sp

Calculation:

Let the Cost price be 100 units

A loss of 60 percent is 60 units

A loss of 30 percent is 30 units

As per the question,

Value of 

⇒ 60 units - 30 units = Rs 150

⇒ 30 units = Rs 150

⇒ 100 units = Rs 500

Cost price is Rs 500

The selling price of the book to gain 20% profit will be,

⇒ 500 + 500 × 20 /100

⇒ 500 + 100 = Rs 600

**∴ The correct option is 2**

questions.question: The diameter of a sphere is 14.7 meter. What will be the volume of the sphere?
questions.solution:
Given:

The diameter of a sphere is 14.7 meters.

Formula used:

Volume of a sphere = 4 / 3 πr3.

The radius of the sphere is r

Diameter = 2 × radius

Calculation:

The radius of the sphere is r = (14.7 / 2) meters.

So, the ratio of the volumes of the sphere will be,

⇒ 4 / 3 × 22 /7 (×14.7 /2)3. = 1663.893 m3

**∴ The correct option is** 1

questions.question: 135 kg of an alloy A is mixed with 72 kg of alloy B to get a new alloy. If alloy A has zinc and copper in the ratio 4 : 5 and alloy B has zinc and copper in ratio 7 : 5, then what is the weight of zinc in the new alloy?
questions.solution:
Given:

135 kg of an alloy A is mixed with 72 kg of alloy B to get a new alloy.

Alloy A has zinc and copper in the ratio 4 : 5

Alloy B has zinc and copper in ratio 7 : 5

Calculation:

The weight of zinc in the alloy A 

⇒ 135 × 4 / 9 = 60 kg

The weight of zinc in the alloy B

⇒ 72 × 7 / 12 = 42 kg

The weight of zinc in the new alloy is , 

⇒ 42 + 60 = 102 kg

**∴ The correct option is 1**

questions.question: Simple Interest received by a person in 15 years on a principal of Rs. 6000 is 150 percent of the principal. What is the annual rate of interest?
questions.solution:
Given:

Simple Interest received by a person in 15 years on a principal of Rs. 6000 is 15 percent of the principal

Formula used:

Simple interest = P × R × T / 100 [ P = principal, R = rate of interest, T = time]

Calculation:

The amount received as Simple interest is,

 6000 × 150 /100 = Rs 9000

As per the formula,

⇒ 9000 = 6000 × R × 15 / 100

⇒ R = 10 %

**∴ The correct option is** **3**

A farmer's land is in the shape of a trapezium which has its parallel sides measuring 7.58 yards and 6.42 yards and the distance between the parallel sides is 6.50 yards. The cost of ploughing the land is Rs. 2000 per square yard. What amount have to be spent in order to plough the entire land?
questions.solution:
Given:

A farmer's land is in the shape of a trapezium which has its parallel sides measuring 7.58 yards and 6.42 yards and the distance between the parallel sides is 6.50 yards.

The cost of plowing the land is Rs. 2000 per square yard.

Concept used:

The area of the trapezium = 1 / 2 × (sum of the parallel sides) × distance between them

Calculation:

The area of the field is,

⇒ 1 / 2 × (7.58 + 6.42 ) × 6.50

⇒ 1 / 2 × (14 ) × 6.50

⇒ 7 × 6.50 = 45.50 square yard

The amount has to be spent in order to plow the entire land,

⇒ 45.50 × 2000 = Rs. 91000

**∴ The correct option is 2**

questions.question: The marked price of a pen is Rs. 5000. The shopkeeper gives two successive discounts of 15 percent and b percent to the customer. If the customer pays Rs. 4080 for the pen, then what is the value of b?
questions.solution:
Given:

The marked price of a pen is Rs. 5000.

The shopkeeper gives two successive discounts of 15 percent and b percent to the customer.

The customer pays Rs. 4080

Concept used:

The discount is calculated on Market Price.

Formula used:

Market price - discount = Selling Price 

Calculation:

The shopkeeper gives a discount of 15 percent,

Now selling price,

⇒ 5000 - 5000 × 15/100

⇒ 5000 - 750 = 4250

He finally pays 4080

So discount offered 4250 - 4080 = 170

Discount percentage will be 

⇒ 170 / 4250 × 100 = 4%

**∴ The correct option is** 4

questions.question: Average of 24 observations is 41. Average of first 9 observations is 42. Average of last 16 observations is 39. What is the value of 9th observation?
questions.solution:
Given:

The average of 24 observations is 41.

The average of first 9 observations is 42.

The average of last 16 observations is 39.

Calculation:

A total of 24 observations is,

⇒ 41 × 24 = 984

The total first of 9 observations is,

⇒ 9 × 42 = 378

The total of the last 16 observations is 

⇒ 16 × 39 = 624

Sum of the total of 25 observation,

⇒ 624 + 378 = 1002

The value of 9th observation is 

⇒ 1002 - 984 = 18

**∴ The correct option is 3**

questions.question: A sum becomes Rs. 33800 in 2 years and Rs. 43,940 in 3 years, when lent in a scheme of compound interest (compounding annually). If double the sum is invested in the same scheme for 2 years, then what will be the amount obtained at end of 2 years?
questions.solution:
Given: 

A sum becomes Rs. 33800 in 2 years and Rs. 43,940 in 3 years, (compounding annually).

Double the sum is invested in the same scheme for 2 years,

Concept used:

For compound interest, Amount = P (1 + R/100)n [ P = principal, R = rate of interest and n = number of years}

Calculation:

Compound interest obtained in 3rd year,

⇒ 43,940 - 33800 = 10140

The rate of interest will be,

⇒ (10140 / 33800) × 100 = 30%

The rate of interest is same so if we doubled the sum the amount is also doubled.

So the amount will also be doubled.

The amount will be, 

⇒ 33800 × 2 = Rs 67600

**∴ The correct option is** 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** The rate of interest is same so if we doubled the sum the amount is also doubled.

So the amount will also be doubled.

The amount will be,

⇒ 33800 × 2 = Rs 67600
